description: KEY FIELDS (per item): `event_kind` (not `kind`), `title`, `summary`, `expected_on` + `date_precision` + `window_end`, `entities[].entity_code` (the canonical code lives here), `entities[].role`, `importance` (1–5), `status`, `certainty`, `scope`. Forward catalyst calendar for the whole A-share market: earnings disclosures, lock-up expiries, buyback deadlines, dividends, IPOs, LPR, macro / policy calendar, major tech conferences, US earnings for A-share supply chains, and forward milestones from broker research and newswires. Answers what is scheduled, never what happened. Filter with `kinds` (prefix wildcards like `macro.*`), `scope`, `codes`, `importance_min`, `statuses`. Pass `precision=day` unless you handle `window_end` yourself. ⚠️ Only `date_precision = day` rows are pinned to a day; for week/month/quarter/half/year rows `expected_on` is the START of the window (`window_end` is the far edge) — never render it as the event date. ⚠️ `expired` does NOT mean it did not happen — the window closed without confirmation reaching us; `cancelled` means withdrawn. `certainty: confirmed` on a research-sourced row is not an exchange filing.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

codes.description: Comma-separated canonical codes (max 200) to narrow to a portfolio

date_to.description: Window end YYYY-MM-DD. Span is capped at 180 days and clamped if longer.

days.description: Forward window in days (1-180, default 14). Ignored when date_to is given.

kinds.description: Comma-separated event_kind filter; prefix wildcards work, e.g. `earnings.disclosure,macro.*`. Kinds: earnings.disclosure, earnings.us_disclosure, ownership.lockup_expiry, buyback.plan_expiry, corp.dividend, ipo.subscription, ipo.listing, macro.data_release, macro.monetary, macro.lpr_release, policy.event, policy.regulation, policy.trade_measure, industry.expo, industry.event, corp.product_launch, corp.capacity_online, corp.price_change, corp.event

limit.description: Max rows (1-1000, default 200). `total` is the true count in the window and is NOT capped by this; `truncated` flags that more exist.

precision.description: `day` = pinned to an actual day; `fuzzy` = period-only rows (`expected_on` is the window START). Omit for both; the two are disjoint. Pass `day` unless you handle `window_end`.

statuses.description: Comma-separated status set; defaults to `scheduled,postponed` (the two open states). Add `occurred` / `expired` to see what already passed.

name: events_upcoming
